metadata.title: Overview | Formula Operations
career.name: Career name
career.emptyBody: Create a Career from a source database to start your own independent world.
career.listBody: Each Career is an independent saved world. Choose one to continue.
career.newBody: Choose a database, season and participating team. Their current content will be copied into a new saved world.
career.snapshotNotice: Later changes to the source database will not change this Career.
career.noSourcesBody: A source database with a season and participating teams is required before a Career can be created.
career.noTeams: This season has no participating teams. Choose another season.
career.storageBody: Your saved Careers could not be loaded. Try again when the database is connected.
career.worldNotice: Career-owned data. Source database edits do not update this world.
career.noEventBody: There are no upcoming calendar events in this Career season.
career.selectSaved: Choose or create a Career. The panels below are the standalone development preview.
career.error.INVALID_NAME: Enter a Career name between 1 and 80 characters.
career.error.INVALID_ID: One of the selected identifiers is invalid. Please select the options again.
career.error.DATABASE_NOT_FOUND: The selected source database no longer exists.
career.error.SEASON_NOT_FOUND: Choose a season belonging to the selected database.
career.error.TEAM_NOT_PARTICIPATING: Choose a team participating in the selected season.
career.error.INVALID_SOURCE: The selected season contains inconsistent roster or calendar data. A Career was not created.
career.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: The database operation failed. Please try again after the connection is restored.
progression.calendarBody: No new season is generated. This Career remains available.
progression.notice: Practice, Qualifying and Sprint sessions are fully simulated: manage them yourself or simulate them with the team's standard programme. Qualifying sets the Grand Prix grid; on a Sprint weekend, Sprint Qualifying sets only the Sprint grid. New races support tyres, track interaction and pit strategy; older saves keep their original rules. No championship points are awarded.
progression.notEntered: This weekend has not been entered. Advance from the Career dashboard.
progression.error.NOT_FOUND: Career, event or session was not found.
progression.error.INVALID_TRANSITION: This action is no longer available. Refresh to see the current session.
progression.error.ACTIVE_WEEKEND: Finish the active weekend before advancing.
progression.error.CALENDAR_COMPLETE: There are no upcoming events in this season.
progression.error.STALE_EVENT: The next event changed. Refresh before advancing.
progression.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: The transition could not be saved. Please try again.
race.title: Race Simulation
race.notice: Development free-air model. Grid and performance profiles are temporary roster-based inputs. No tyres, traffic/overtaking, pit stops, weather or failures.
race.ready: Ready to snapshot inputs and start the Race.
race.unavailable: This session cannot start a Race. Legacy development completions have no classification.
race.error.INVALID_ACTION: This Race action is not available.
race.error.STALE: Race state changed. Refresh before trying again.
race.error.INVALID_INPUT: The roster, compound choices or simulation profile is outside supported limits.
race.error.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This saved simulation version is not supported.
race.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: Race progress could not be saved. Please try again.
tyre.notice: Tyre development model: one dry stint, no tyre changes. Wear means consumed life: 0% fresh, 100% maximum wear. Long races may reach severe degradation. No pits, traffic/overtaking or weather.
tyre.legacy: Legacy version-1 race: original free-air rules remain active, without tyres. No pit stops, traffic or weather.
tyre.lockedAfterStart: Choose before starting. Compounds are frozen for this race; no tyre changes are available.
tyre.title: Tyre Development Model
traffic.notice: Development race interaction model: explicit track order, dirty air, overtaking and DRS. DRS and traffic indicators describe the last completed lap. Tyre wear means consumed life. No pits, weather or blue flags.
traffic.title: Race interaction model
pit.notice: Development race strategy model: dry tyre stops, stints and track interaction. Pit-cycle position changes are not on-track overtakes. No weather, ERS, incidents or pit-box queues.
pit.semantics: Box requests commit on the next lap advance. The stop occurs after that completed lap, before the following lap. Change or cancel the request before advancing. The tyre-cliff estimate is not a strategy guarantee.
pit.onTrack: On track · no pending pit request
pit.estimate: Estimated pit window: {laps} laps to tyre cliff
pit.ai: Temporary AI strategy: same tyres and pit costs as player cars.
pit.startingNotice: Choose the starting tyres. During the race, request a pit stop to fit a new compound.
command.title: Driver commands
command.timing: Changes apply on the next lap. Negative projected fuel requires saving fuel; insufficient fuel adds a severe lap penalty.
command.ai: AI manages pace, fuel and ERS using the same resources and mechanics.
command.notice: Development race model: pace commands, fuel modes, ERS, dry tyre stops and track interaction. Pit-cycle position changes are not on-track overtakes. Weather, incidents, safety interventions and pit-box queues remain deferred.
weather.title: Weather
weather.DRS_DISABLED_WET: DRS disabled due to wet conditions
weather.uncertainty: Approximate arrival windows and intensity ranges. Conditions between windows may change; this is not the exact weather timeline.
weather.notice: Development weather model: rainfall changes track water gradually. Tyre suitability, temperature and wear drive crossover strategy. Wet conditions may disable DRS. Incidents, safety interventions and final Race UI remain deferred.
incident.notice: Development race: incidents, reliability and Race Control use provisional, deterministic tuning. No red flags or unlapping.
viewer.title: Race operations
viewer.commandPause: Saving a command pauses playback. Resume when both cars are ready.
viewer.positionNote: Position change is relative to the grid, including pit cycles.
viewer.interpolation: Visual positions interpolate saved laps. Timing and classification remain authoritative.
viewer.error: The action could not be completed. Playback is paused. Refresh to load the latest checkpoint before retrying.
viewer.reason.INCIDENT: Your driver had an incident. Playback paused.
viewer.reason.PIT: Your pit stop completed. Playback paused.
viewer.drs.RESTART: DRS disabled · returns in {count} green laps
viewer.tyreLife: Estimated tyre life: ~{count} laps to cliff
viewer.estimateNote: Estimate from current wear and pace mode, not an instruction.
viewer.noCommands.RETIRED: Retired on lap {lap}. Commands are no longer available.
viewer.noCommands.FINISHED: Finished. Commands are no longer available.
viewer.labelNote: Map labels show your cars, their battles and the leader; select any car to identify it.
viewer.phase.seeking: Seeking next strategic event · up to {limit} laps
viewer.reason.COMMAND: Command saved. Playback stays paused — press Resume to continue.
viewer.attention.FUEL: {driver} fuel projected short at the finish
viewer.attention.BATTLE_AHEAD: {driver} in a close battle with the car ahead
prep.rivalNote: Rival teams choose their own starting tyres from the grid conditions at the start.
viewer.suitNote.SLICK_DAMP: slicks losing grip on a damp track
viewer.suitNote.INTER_DRY: intermediates overheating on a dry track
viewer.suitNote.WET_DRY: wet tyres overheating on a dry track
viewer.suitNote.WET_DAMP: wet tyres on a drying track
viewer.suitNote.WET_OK: wet tyres on a wet track
viewer.ersLaps: About {count} laps of deployment left in this mode
viewer.ersSustainable: Charge holds steady in this mode
practice.title: Practice
practice.intro: Plan runs for both cars, learn the car and the tyres, and use driver feedback to refine the setup. What your drivers learn carries into the rest of this weekend (a Sprint weekend has only Practice 1).
practice.ready: This session is ready to start.
practice.unavailable: This session is not available yet.
practice.simulateSessionConfirm: Your cars will be run by the team's standard programme for the whole session. Continue?
practice.simulateRemainderConfirm: Your cars will be run by the team's standard programme until the chequered flag. Continue?
practice.simulateAllConfirm: Every remaining Practice session of this weekend will be simulated with the team's standard programme. This cannot be undone.
practice.chequered: Chequered flag — cars returning to the garage
practice.reason.GARAGE: {driver} is back in the garage. Playback paused.
practice.reason.LIMIT: Advanced {minutes} minutes without a relevant event. Playback paused.
practice.confirm.setup: setup change started in the garage
practice.timingNote: Positions are by best lap time. Out laps and in laps are not timed.
practice.mapNote: Cars in the garage are not shown on the map.
practice.rivalNote: Rival setups, run plans and driver feedback are not visible.
practice.autoManaged: The team's standard programme is running this car.
practice.lapsFit: Up to {max} timed laps fit in the remaining time.
practice.noTime: Not enough time remains for another run.
practice.paceNote.CONSERVATIVE: Slower laps, gentler on the tyres.
practice.fitNote.UNSUITED: Unsuited to current conditions; little will be learned.
practice.confidenceHint: How settled the driver feels with this setup — not how close it is to the best setup.
practice.setupNote: Changes are made in the garage, take about two minutes and briefly lower confidence.
practice.setupLocked: Setup can only be changed while the car is in the garage.
practice.noFeedback: No driver feedback yet: complete timed laps to hear from your driver.
practice.feedbackStale: Feedback refers to the previous setup.
practice.dimHint.AERO: Low: straight-line speed · High: cornering grip
practice.dimHint.MECHANICAL: Low: softer, more grip · High: stiffer, more response
practice.dimHint.RIDE: Low: more downforce · High: kerbs and bumps
practice.dimHint.TYRE: Low: grip and warm-up · High: stability and wear
practice.carryOver: Setup, feedback and driver knowledge carry into the next session of this weekend.
practice.error.NOT_FOUND: The session could not be found.
practice.error.INVALID_ACTION: That action is not available right now.
practice.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: The session could not be saved. Playback is paused; refresh before retrying.
practice.error.STALE: The session changed in the meantime. Refresh to load the latest state.
practice.error.NOT_IN_GARAGE: The car must be in the garage.
practice.error.NOT_READY: Garage work is still in progress.
practice.error.NOT_ON_TRACK: The car is not on track.
practice.error.PLAN_INVALID: The run plan is not valid.
practice.error.PLAN_TOO_LONG: The run does not fit in the remaining time.
practice.simulateHint: Not managing a session yourself? Choose Simulate session: the team's standard programme runs your cars with the same mechanics, and your drivers still learn from it.
career.teamPickerHint: You manage both of this team's race drivers. The other {count} teams are run by the AI.
qualifying.title: Qualifying
qualifying.intro: Q1, Q2 and Q3 decide the Race starting grid. Manage both cars yourself — tyres, timing, traffic and the cutoff — or let the team's standard programme run the session. Your setup and learning carry over from Practice.
qualifying.unavailable: Qualifying is not available yet. Complete Practice first.
qualifying.legacyInProgress: This Qualifying session was opened in an earlier version of the game, before Qualifying was simulated, so no running was recorded. Resuming starts it from the beginning of Q1.
qualifying.legacyCompleted: This Qualifying was completed by an earlier development placeholder, so there are no results. The Race uses the development starting order.
qualifying.simulateConfirm: Your cars will be run by the team's standard programme through Q1, Q2 and Q3, with the same mechanics. The result sets the Race grid. Continue?
qualifying.remainderConfirm: Your cars will be run by the team's standard programme for the rest of Qualifying, keeping every lap already set. Continue?
qualifying.simulateHint: Not managing Qualifying yourself? Choose Simulate Qualifying: the same engine runs Q1–Q3 and sets the Race grid.
qualifying.finished: Qualifying complete. The Race grid is set.
qualifying.cutoffLine: Cutoff: P{position} advances — below this line is the elimination zone
qualifying.towerNote: Only times from the current phase count. Eliminated cars keep their final position.
qualifying.fuelNote: Fuel is set automatically for the plan; each extra push lap carries a little more.
qualifying.garageWork: Tyres and fuel being changed in the garage.
qualifying.noTimeForRun: Not enough time remains to start another timed lap.
qualifying.lastLapTraffic: Traffic cost time on this lap
qualifying.eliminatedNote: Eliminated in {phase}: starts from P{position}. This car is now read-only.
qualifying.rivalNote: Rival plans and setups are not visible.
qualifying.setupLocked: Qualifying uses the setup carried from Practice; it cannot be changed now.
qualifying.breakNote: A 7-minute break follows; conditions may change during it.
qualifying.gridNote: This classification is the Race starting grid.
sprintQualifying.title: Sprint Qualifying
sprintQualifying.intro: SQ1, SQ2 and SQ3 decide the Sprint starting grid (not the Grand Prix grid). Manage both cars yourself — tyres, timing, traffic and the cutoff — or let the team's standard programme run the session. Your setup and learning carry over from Practice 1.
sprintQualifying.simulateConfirm: Your cars will be run by the team's standard programme through SQ1, SQ2 and SQ3, with the same mechanics. The result sets the Sprint grid. Continue?
sprintQualifying.remainderConfirm: Your cars will be run by the team's standard programme for the rest of Sprint Qualifying, keeping every lap already set. Continue?
sprintQualifying.simulateHint: Not managing Sprint Qualifying yourself? Choose Simulate Sprint Qualifying: the same engine runs SQ1–SQ3 and sets the Sprint grid.
sprintQualifying.finished: Sprint Qualifying complete. The Sprint grid is set.
sprintQualifying.gridNote: This classification is the Sprint starting grid. The Grand Prix grid comes from Qualifying later this weekend.
sprintQualifying.setupLocked: Sprint Qualifying uses the setup carried from Practice 1; it cannot be changed now.
sprintQualifying.ready: Sprint Qualifying is ready to start.
sprintQualifying.unavailable: Sprint Qualifying is not available yet. Complete Practice 1 first.
sprint.title: Sprint
sprint.simulateConfirm: Both your cars will be run by the team's standard programme for the whole Sprint — tyres, pit stops, pace and ERS — on the same Race engine as a managed Sprint. The result is final. Continue?
sprint.remainderConfirm: Both your cars will be auto-managed for the rest of the Sprint from the current lap, keeping everything already done. The result is final. Continue?
sprint.ready: The Sprint is ready to start. The grid is the Sprint Qualifying result.
sprint.unavailable: The Sprint is not available yet. Complete Sprint Qualifying first.
sprint.gridNote: Starting grid: the Sprint Qualifying result. The Sprint does not set the Grand Prix grid.
sprint.resultNote: Qualifying — not this Sprint — sets the Grand Prix grid. Championship points are not awarded yet.
sprint.simulateHint: Not managing the Sprint yourself? Choose Simulate Sprint: the same Race engine runs every lap with both your cars auto-managed.
qualifying.reason.ZONE_IN: {driver} dropped into the elimination zone. Playback paused.
qualifying.reason.ZONE_OUT: {driver} moved out of the elimination zone. Playback paused.
qualifying.reason.CUTOFF: The cutoff time moved. Playback paused.
qualifying.reason.FLAG: Chequered flag: only laps already started can still count. Playback paused.
qualifying.reason.LIMIT: No relevant event within the seek limit. Playback paused.
qualifying.error.INVALID_ACTION: That action is not available right now.
qualifying.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: Qualifying could not be saved. Playback is paused; refresh before retrying.
qualifying.error.STALE: Qualifying changed in the meantime. Refresh to load the latest state.
qualifying.error.PHASE_COMPLETE: This phase is complete. Continue to the next phase.
qualifying.error.CLOCK_EXPIRED: The clock has run out; no new run can start.
qualifying.error.NOT_IN_GARAGE: The car must be in the garage.
qualifying.error.NOT_READY: The car is still being prepared.
qualifying.error.NOT_ON_TRACK: The car is not on track.
qualifying.error.PLAN_INVALID: The run plan is not valid.
championship.title: Championship
championship.seasonCompleteBody: Every Grand Prix has been run. These are the final standings.
championship.tiedLegend: “=” marks a tie: equal points and equal countback (Grand Prix finishes, then Grand Prix Qualifying).
championship.noResultsBody: Standings appear once a Sprint or a Grand Prix is completed.
championship.historyEmpty: No Grand Prix has been completed yet.
championship.rulesNote: Grand Prix 25-18-15-12-10-8-6-4-2-1 · Sprint 8-7-6-5-4-3-2-1 · no fastest-lap point · no Qualifying points.
championship.noScore: Less than the scoring distance — no points awarded
championship.dataNote: Standings are calculated from completed results only.
qualifying.error.PLAN_TOO_LONG: The last push lap would start after the flag.
